title: Conformal Policy Selection: When to Deploy AI Decisions for Targeted Intervention
abstract: arXiv:2610.22930v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial-intelligence (AI) policies are increasingly used to make consequential decisions in medicine, finance, education, and public services, yet deploying them responsibly requires knowing not only whether a policy helps on average, but for whom. Existing tools for off-policy evaluation and safe policy learning provide population-level guarantees, but some individuals may experience adverse treatment effects. We recast targeted deployment as a multiple-testing problem: for each candidate unit, test whether the outcome under the AI policy would exceed a user-specified threshold, and control the false discovery rate (FDR) among the selected set. Our method, Conformal Policy Selection, combines weighted conformal $p$-values that account for the distributional shift from behavior to target policy with a two-step selection-and-pruning procedure. translated_title: 共形策略选择：何时部署AI决策以进行针对性干预
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）策略正日益被用于在医学、金融、教育和公共服务等领域做出影响重大的决策，然而要负责任地部署这些策略，不仅需要知道一项策略在平均意义上是否有帮助，还需要知道它对谁有帮助。现有的离线策略评估和安全策略学习工具提供的是总体层面的保证，但某些个体仍可能遭受不利的处理效应。我们将针对性部署重新构建为一个多重检验问题：对于每个候选单元，检验其在AI策略下的结果是否会超过用户指定的阈值，并在被选中的集合中控制错误发现率（FDR）。我们的方法“共形策略选择”将能够考虑从行为策略到目标策略分布偏移的加权共形p值，与两步选择-剪枝程序相结合。我们证明了有限样本下的FDR控制，并建立了双重稳健的渐近保证。
tldr: 该论文提出“共形策略选择”方法，将AI策略的针对性部署建模为多重检验问题，通过加权共形p值与两步选择-剪枝程序在控制错误发现率的前提下识别出能从AI策略中受益的个体，实现了有限样本FDR控制和双重稳健的渐近保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Conformal Policy Selection, which recasts targeted AI policy deployment as a multiple-testing problem, combining weighted conformal p-values with a two-step selection-and-pruning procedure to identify individuals who benefit from the AI policy while achieving finite-sample FDR control and doubly robust asymptotic guarantees.
